    • Regular Season Start: Week 1 games are scheduled for Sep 4-9, 2026.
    • Early 2026 Schedule Highlights: A historic game in Australia between the Los Angeles Rams and San Francisco 49ers will be played, along with games expected in Brazil, notes. 
    You can find the full, finalized schedule and team-specific matchups on the official NFL Schedule page.
